methodology: Each curve is a real sold-price timeline: every point is a reported eBay sold (or presale) from the named hobby tracker, with its date and kind. The pattern shown — launch sellout → aftermarket premium spike → cooling toward retail — is documented, not predicted. No Chronicle price index exists; curves appear only where a tracker publishes ≥3 dated sold points. Presale points are labeled as presale, never mixed with solds.
